script: Players RETURNED to the Team That TRADED Them. So Gary Payton II was a huge part of the Golden State Warriors winning the title in twenty twenty two. He wasn't exactly a star scorer, but he made up with his defense since he was the guy who locked up the other team's best player every single night, and Warriors fans loved him for it. Then that summer, the Warriors let him leave, and he signed a three year, twenty-six million dollar deal with the Portland Trail Blazers. But letting him walk turned into a decision the Warriors would spend the whole season regretting. At the trade deadline in February, Golden State pulled off a giant four-team trade where they sent James Wiseman, a former number two overall pick, to the Detroit Pistons, and when the dust settled, Gary Payton the second was headed right back home to the Warriors. Fans were thrilled because the defense was coming back for another title run. But less than twenty-four hours after the deal was done, the entire thing nearly collapsed. See, Payton had core muscle surgery before the season, and when he took his physical, Golden State didn't like what they saw and actually believed Portland hid important medical information about his health. They were so upset they looked into taking action against the Blazers, and the whole trade sat frozen for days while Golden State had until Sunday night to either walk away or push it through. And here's the wild part. The night before he got traded, Gary Payton played against the Warriors and beat them, then he switched jerseys and rejoined the exact team he just defeated.
